scriptEn.hook: Three more World Cup stories you missed.

stories.headline: Scotland mark World Cup return with a 1-0 win over Haiti
stories.summary: Scotland marked its return to the World Cup with a 1-0 win over Haiti. Midfielder John McGinn scored the only goal in the 28th minute. After years of near-misses, the Scots finally have a World Cup win and a strong start in their group.

keyword.definitionEn: a return to success after a long absence or setback

stories.commentQuestion: How far can Scotland go at this World Cup?

stories.headline: Co-host Canada held to a 1-1 draw by Bosnia
stories.summary: Co-host Canada was held to a 1-1 draw by Bosnia and Herzegovina in its opening match. Cyle Larin came off the bench to rescue a point. While the United States started with a big win, Canada will feel it dropped two points at home.

keyword.definitionEn: a goal that makes the score even

stories.commentQuestion: Can co-hosts Canada still reach the knockout rounds?

stories.headline: Qatar hold Switzerland to a 1-1 draw in Group B
stories.summary: Qatar earned a battling 1-1 draw with Switzerland in Group B. The result was a small surprise, with Qatar holding a higher-ranked European side. Every point matters in the new 48-team format, where more third-placed teams can still advance.

keyword.definitionEn: the team or player expected to lose

stories.commentQuestion: Which smaller nation has impressed you most so far?

todaysWord.definitionEn: a return to success after a long absence or setback

scriptEn.close: That's your World Cup in sixty. Follow for more.

stories.headline: スコットランド、W杯復帰戦でハイチに1-0勝利
stories.summary: スコットランドがW杯復帰戦でハイチを1-0で下した。MFジョン・マッギンが28分に決勝点。あと一歩が続いた年月を経て、ついにW杯での勝利をつかみ、グループで好スタートを切った。

stories.headline: 共催国カナダ、ボスニアと1-1ドロー
stories.summary: 共催国カナダが初戦でボスニア・ヘルツェゴビナと1-1で引き分けた。途中出場のサイル・ラリンが追いつき勝ち点1を拾う。アメリカが大勝した一方、地元のカナダは2点を取りこぼした形だ。

stories.headline: カタールがスイスと1-1、グループBで健闘
stories.summary: カタールがグループBでスイスと1-1の引き分けに持ち込んだ。格上の欧州勢を抑えるささやかな驚き。48カ国制では3位でも勝ち上がれる枠が増え、勝ち点1の価値は大きい。
